verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's documented 'self-improving database' lets an agent run on a recurring schedule to review production Insights/Schema Recommendations and autonomously open pull requests with performance improvements, and the MCP server/service-token setup supports headless/CI agent use for this exact background automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that these scheduled agent runs work reliably in production, and more detail on configuring/monitoring the automation lifecycle.
